note: Two candidate lines per photograph for Al to pick, written to review/HUMOUR-DOCTRINE.md and review/PAIRING-TASTE.md under today's registers (partly-cloudy: the half-and-half sky is the app's own 'probably'; breezy: useful or cheeky, never destructive; cloudy: honest mediocrity). Keyed by the brief's filename until ingestion, when scripts/ingest-new-sets.mjs converts each key to the image hash. Afrikaans drafts sit beside every English line; each went through lang-check (af) and its verdict is recorded. AF is Al's to rule; zu/xh/st go to the native-review backlog. Braai is named only on Saturday and Sunday frames; a named weekday always matches the photograph's slot.

candidates.en: Monday's sky is half blue, half undecided. Same as the spaza's shutter.
candidates.af: Maandag se lug is half blou, half onbeslis. Net soos die spaza se rolluik.

candidates.en: Clouds and sun are sharing the Monday shift. Nobody's properly clocked in yet.
candidates.af: Wolke en son deel die Maandagskof. Niemand het nog regtig ingeklok nie.

candidates.en: The sun keeps ducking behind a cloud. The joggers aren't waiting for it.
candidates.af: Die son duik heeltyd agter 'n wolk in. Die drawwers wag nie daarvoor nie.

candidates.en: Probably sunny, probably cloudy, definitely humid. Durban runs on all three.
candidates.af: Waarskynlik sonnig, waarskynlik bewolk, beslis klam. Durban draf op al drie.

candidates.en: Enough cloud to make the farmer look up. Not enough to make him hope.
candidates.af: Genoeg wolke dat die boer opkyk. Nie genoeg dat hy begin hoop nie.

candidates.en: Wednesday dawn on the farm: clouds passing through, not one stopping to water anything.
candidates.af: Woensdagoggend op die plaas: die wolke trek verby, en nie een gee iets water nie.

candidates.en: A cloud shadow works the vines row by row. So does the tractor.
candidates.af: 'n Wolkskadu werk die wingerd ry vir ry deur. Die trekker ook.

candidates.en: Sun on this row, shade on the next. The vines are taking turns.
candidates.af: Son op hierdie ry, skadu op die volgende. Die wingerdstokke vat beurte.

candidates.en: Friday's clouds are just for decoration. Pretoria hired them to match the jacarandas.
candidates.af: Vrydag se wolke is net vir versiering. Pretoria het hulle gehuur om by die jakarandas te pas.

candidates.en: Sun's out for the paper run. No promises about the rest of Friday.
candidates.af: Die son is uit vir die koerant. Geen beloftes oor die res van Vrydag nie.

candidates.en: A cloud or two for shade on the way back. That's Saturday's plan.
candidates.af: 'n Wolk of twee vir skaduwee op pad terug. Dis Saterdag se plan.

candidates.en: Saturday's sky left a few clouds out over the sea. Nobody running is complaining.
candidates.af: Saterdag se lug het 'n paar wolke oor die see gelos. Niemand wat draf kla nie.

findings: 'paar' means 'pair; to pair, to couple; couple' — nothing in the English source; it is 1 letter from 'vaar', the usual word for 'running'

candidates.en: Sunday clouds drift past the baobab, slow as the morning. Nobody's rushing them.
candidates.af: Sondagwolke dryf by die kremetart verby, so stadig soos die oggend. Niemand jaag hulle nie.

candidates.en: The smoke goes straight up, the clouds go sideways. Sunday has room for both.
candidates.af: Die rook trek reguit op, die wolke skuif sywaarts. Sondag het plek vir albei.

candidates.en: Table Mountain's tablecloth is only half on. It's Monday, nobody's fully dressed for it.
candidates.af: Tafelberg se tafeldoek is net half op. Dis Maandag, niemand is heeltemal reg aangetrek nie.

candidates.en: Sun on one side of the street, cloud on the other. Monday couldn't commit.
candidates.af: Son aan die een kant van die straat, wolk aan die ander. Maandag kon nie besluit nie.

candidates.en: Cloud shadows keep walking across the outfield. The umpire hasn't given them out yet.
candidates.af: Wolkskaduwees stap heeltyd oor die buiteveld. Die skeidsregter het hulle nog nie uitgegee nie.

candidates.en: Enough cloud to rest the outfield. Not enough to call off the match.
candidates.af: Genoeg wolke om die buiteveld te laat rus. Nie genoeg om die wedstryd af te gelas nie.

candidates.en: Sun, cloud, sun again. The monkeys on the wall wait for the good bits.
candidates.af: Son, wolk, en weer son. Die ape op die muur wag vir die lekker stukke.

candidates.en: Wednesday afternoon in Durban: clouds over the ridge, humidity over everything else.
candidates.af: Woensdagmiddag in Durban: wolke oor die rant, vogtigheid oor alles anders.

candidates.en: The dog found the exact line between sun and cloud. He's staying on it.
candidates.af: Die hond het die presiese lyn tussen son en wolk gekry. Hy bly net daar.

candidates.en: Karoo noon with clouds, for once. The town treats the shade like a holiday.
candidates.af: Karoo-middag met wolke, vir 'n slag. Die dorp behandel die skaduwee soos 'n vakansie.

candidates.en: Sunglasses on, a cloud comes. Sunglasses off, the sun's back. Friday has a rhythm.
candidates.af: Sonbril op, 'n wolk kom. Sonbril af, die son is terug. Vrydag het 'n ritme.

candidates.en: The clouds keep stealing the sun. This table isn't letting them steal Friday.
candidates.af: Die wolke steel heeltyd die son. Hierdie tafel laat hulle nie Vrydag steel nie.

candidates.en: The braai's lit, a cloud is passing, and nobody is changing Saturday's plans.
candidates.af: Die braai brand, 'n wolk trek verby, en niemand verander Saterdag se planne nie.

candidates.en: A cloud over Paarl Rock, a fire in the braai. Both staying for lunch.
candidates.af: 'n Wolk oor die Paarlrots, 'n vuur in die braai. Albei bly vir middagete.

candidates.en: A cloud crosses the sun; gran doesn't even look up. The potjie's nearly done.
candidates.af: 'n Wolk skuif voor die son en ouma kyk nie eers op nie. Die potjie is amper gaar.

candidates.en: Under the lapa: sun on the lawn, cloud on the Magaliesberg, potjie for everyone.
candidates.af: Onder die lapa: son op die grasperk, wolk op die Magaliesberg, potjie vir almal.

candidates.en: The clouds stayed just to catch the colour. Monday ends better than it began.
candidates.af: Die wolke het net gebly om die kleur te vang. Maandag eindig beter as wat dit begin het.

candidates.en: No clouds, no colour. Sea Point got the full sunset on a Monday.
candidates.af: Geen wolke, geen kleur nie. Seepunt kry die volle sonsondergang op 'n Maandag.

candidates.en: The clouds walked past without a drop. The hose is doing their job again.
candidates.af: Die wolke het sonder 'n druppel verbygestap. Die tuinslang doen weer hulle werk.

candidates.en: Clouds all afternoon and not one drop. Tuesday's watering is still his department.
candidates.af: Wolke die hele middag en nie een druppel nie. Dinsdag se natlei is steeds sy departement.

candidates.en: The clouds are putting on a show at Nahoon. The fish are not.
candidates.af: Die wolke hou 'n vertoning by Nahoon. Die visse nie.

candidates.en: Every cloud at Nahoon went pink on cue. The fish missed theirs entirely.
candidates.af: Elke wolk by Nahoon het op die regte oomblik pienk geword. Die visse het hulle s'n heeltemal gemis.

candidates.en: Clouds over Upington, and none of them carry rain. The sprinklers know the drill.
candidates.af: Wolke oor Upington, en nie een dra reën nie. Die sprinkelaars ken die storie.

candidates.en: A few clouds for the sunset, none for the vines. The sprinklers stay on.
candidates.af: 'n Paar wolke vir die sonsondergang, geen vir die wingerd nie. Die sprinkelaars bly aan.

candidates.en: Sun's gone, clouds still lit. Friday in Hatfield is only warming up.
candidates.af: Die son is weg, die wolke brand nog. Vrydag in Hatfield word eers warm.

candidates.en: The clouds hold the last of the light. The balcony holds everything else.
candidates.af: Die wolke hou die laaste lig vas. Die balkon sorg vir die res.

candidates.en: Saturday's clouds turned pink right on time for packing up. Nobody's packing up.
candidates.af: Saterdag se wolke het presies betyds pienk geword vir inpak. Niemand pak in nie.

candidates.en: The clouds kept the sun soft all afternoon. Now they're just showing off.
candidates.af: Die wolke het die son die hele middag sag gehou. Nou pronk hulle net.

findings: 'gehou' means 'to hold; to keep; hit' — nothing in the English source; it is 1 letter from 'behou', the usual word for 'kept'
afCheck.note: false alarm: sag gehou = kept soft

candidates.en: The cattle are home before the clouds lose their colour. Sunday ends on time.
candidates.af: Die beeste is tuis voor die wolke hulle kleur verloor. Sondag eindig betyds.

candidates.en: The Berg holds the light, the clouds hold the pink. The cattle keep walking.
candidates.af: Die Berg hou die lig vas, die wolke hou die pienk. Die beeste stap net aan.

candidates.en: The moon keeps ducking behind the clouds. The security light has no such option.
candidates.af: Die maan duik heeltyd agter die wolke in. Die sekuriteitslig het nie daai keuse nie.

candidates.en: Moon out, moon in, moon out again. Monday night can't settle either.
candidates.af: Maan uit, maan in, maan weer uit. Maandagaand kan ook nie tot rus kom nie.

candidates.en: Moonlit clouds over Devil's Peak, and the bin is going out. Tuesday's highlight.
candidates.af: Maanlig-wolke oor Duiwelspiek, en die asblik gaan uit. Dinsdag se hoogtepunt.

candidates.en: The clouds keep borrowing the moon. He'll find the gate without it.
candidates.af: Die wolke leen heeltyd die maan. Hy sal die hek sonder die maan kry.

candidates.en: The moon comes and goes. The forecourt mast light has never once left.
candidates.af: Die maan kom en gaan. Die masligte by die vulstasie het nog nooit eers weggegaan nie.

candidates.en: Half a sky of stars, half of cloud. Bloem is fine with half.
candidates.af: Half 'n lug vol sterre, half vol wolke. Bloem is tevrede met half.

candidates.en: The clouds have the moon on a dimmer. The balcony isn't complaining.
candidates.af: Die wolke hou die maan op 'n dimskakelaar. Die balkon kla nie.

candidates.en: Warm night, broken cloud, a moon that keeps coming back. Thursday's working out fine.
candidates.af: Warm nag, gebreekte wolke, 'n maan wat aanhou terugkom. Donderdag werk mooi uit.

candidates.en: The moon shows up between clouds now and then. The fire stays all night.
candidates.af: Die maan wys nou en dan tussen die wolke deur. Die vuur bly die hele nag.

candidates.en: The clouds are keeping half the moon for later. Friday doesn't wait for later.
candidates.af: Die wolke hou die helfte van die maan vir later. Vrydag wag nie vir later nie.

candidates.en: Moonlit clouds over the mountains, coals still glowing. Saturday has no reason to end.
candidates.af: Maanlig-wolke oor die berge, die kole gloei nog. Saterdag het geen rede om te eindig nie.

candidates.en: The clouds are covering half the stars. The fairy lights are covering the rest.
candidates.af: Die wolke bedek die helfte van die sterre. Die liggies in die boom doen die res.

candidates.en: Moon behind a cloud, stoep light on duty. The dog approves.
candidates.af: Maan agter 'n wolk, stoeplig aan diens. Die hond keur dit goed.

candidates.en: Karoo Sunday night: one moon, a few clouds, and absolutely nothing else happening.
candidates.af: Karoo-Sondagaand: een maan, 'n paar wolke, en verder gebeur daar absoluut niks nie.

candidates.en: The breeze was up before the surfers. The flag's already giving the forecast.
candidates.af: Die briesie was voor die branderplankryers op. Die vlag gee al klaar die voorspelling.

candidates.en: Monday at Muizenberg: the wind's tidying the whitecaps and untidying everyone's hair.
candidates.af: Maandag by Muizenberg: die wind maak die skuimkoppe netjies en almal se hare deurmekaar.

candidates.en: The breeze wants that scarf more than she does. She's winning, for now.
candidates.af: Die briesie wil daai serp meer hê as sy. Sy wen, vir nou.

candidates.en: Jacaranda petals are taking the bus too. The breeze bought them all tickets.
candidates.af: Die jakarandablommetjies ry ook bus. Die briesie het vir almal kaartjies gekoop.

candidates.en: The windpump has work today. The grass is just showing off about it.
candidates.af: Die windpomp het vandag werk. Die gras spog net daaroor.

candidates.en: Steady breeze, steady windpump. Wednesday's water is taking care of itself.
candidates.af: Bestendige briesie, bestendige windpomp. Woensdag se water sorg vir homself.

candidates.en: Hand on the cap, one stride at a time. The breeze sets her pace.
candidates.af: Hand op die pet, een tree op 'n slag. Die briesie bepaal haar pas.

candidates.en: Palms swaying, umbrella flapping, Durban sunrise. The breeze is the only one not sweating.
candidates.af: Palmbome swaai, sambreel klap, Durbanse sonsopkoms. Die briesie is die enigste een wat nie sweet nie.

candidates.en: The washing will be dry before school is out. The breeze clocked in early.
candidates.af: Die wasgoed sal droog wees voor die skool uitkom. Die briesie het vroeg ingeklok.

candidates.en: Friday breeze, full washing line. Gqeberha's free tumble dryer is on.
candidates.af: Vrydagbriesie, vol wasgoeddraad. Gqeberha se gratis tuimeldroër is aan.

candidates.en: A little dust devil is riding ahead of him. It isn't even pedalling.
candidates.af: 'n Klein stofduiweltjie ry voor hom uit. Dit trap nie eers nie.

candidates.en: Saturday in the Karoo: light breeze, one dust devil out for a training ride.
candidates.af: Saterdag in die Karoo: ligte briesie, een stofduiwel uit vir 'n oefenrit.

candidates.en: Sunday breeze through the pines. Her hair got to the bakery before she did.
candidates.af: Sondagbriesie deur die dennebome. Haar hare was voor haar by die bakkery.

candidates.en: A soft breeze down the main road. Even the pines are taking it easy.
candidates.af: 'n Sagte briesie in die hoofstraat af. Selfs die dennebome vat dit rustig.

candidates.en: Monday break-time, and the breeze is in charge of everyone's hair. Teachers included.
candidates.af: Maandagpouse, en die briesie is in beheer van almal se hare. Onderwysers ingesluit.

candidates.en: The papers are staying put. The leaves and the ponytails have other plans.
candidates.af: Die papiere bly waar hulle is. Die blare en die poniesterte het ander planne.

candidates.en: The awning's flapping, the palms are swaying, and the pineapples aren't going anywhere.
candidates.af: Die afdak klap, die palmbome swaai, en die pynappels gaan nêrens heen nie.

candidates.en: A Durban breeze at the fruit stall: free air conditioning with every pineapple.
candidates.af: 'n Durbanse briesie by die vrugtestalletjie: gratis lugversorging by elke pynappel.

candidates.en: Perfect kite wind. The willows are cheering and the dog's ears agree.
candidates.af: Perfekte vlieërwind. Die treurwilgers juig en die hond se ore stem saam.

candidates.en: The breeze does all the hard work. The kite takes all the credit.
candidates.af: Die briesie doen al die harde werk. Die vlieër vat al die eer.

candidates.en: The corner flag is pointing out exactly where the conversions are going to drift.
candidates.af: Die hoekvlag wys presies waarheen die doelskoppe gaan dryf.

candidates.en: Steady breeze across the field. Every kick at goal comes with a weather lesson.
candidates.af: Bestendige briesie oor die veld. Elke skop na die pale kom met 'n weerles.

candidates.en: The sheets will be dry by lunch. The shopping-bag kite is a bonus.
candidates.af: Die lakens sal teen middagete droog wees. Die winkelsakvlieër is 'n bonus.

candidates.en: Full washing lines and a shopping-bag kite. Gqeberha wastes none of its wind.
candidates.af: Vol wasgoeddrade en 'n winkelsakvlieër. Gqeberha mors niks van sy wind nie.

candidates.en: The smoke has found the neighbours' yard. Saturday's braai is officially a community event.
candidates.af: Die rook het die bure se erf gekry. Saterdag se braai is amptelik 'n gemeenskapsgeleentheid.

candidates.en: Tablecloth lifting, pool rippling, smoke going sideways. The breeze accepted the braai invitation.
candidates.af: Die tafeldoek lig, die swembad rimpel, die rook trek dwars. Die briesie het die braai-uitnodiging aanvaar.

candidates.en: The blanket is held down with shoes. The windsurfers got the better deal.
candidates.af: Die kombers word met skoene vasgehou. Die seilplankryers het die beter deal gekry.

candidates.en: Enough breeze for the windsurfers, not quite enough to steal lunch. Langebaan delivers.
candidates.af: Genoeg briesie vir die seilplankryers, net nie genoeg om die middagete te steel nie. Langebaan lewer.

candidates.en: The flags are standing at attention. The wine glass is held a little tighter.
candidates.af: Die vlae staan op aandag. Die wynglas word 'n bietjie stywer vasgehou.

candidates.en: Table Mountain in gold, a breeze off the bay, hair everywhere. Monday's going well.
candidates.af: Tafelberg in goud, 'n briesie van die baai af, hare oral. Maandag gaan goed.

candidates.en: The breeze lifts the dust into the gold light. The match carries on.
candidates.af: Die briesie lig die stof op in die goue lig. Die wedstryd gaan aan.

candidates.en: The tyre swing is moving on its own. The breeze wants a turn too.
candidates.af: Die bandswaai beweeg vanself. Die briesie wil ook 'n beurt hê.

candidates.en: The grass is moving in waves across the hill. The cattle haven't noticed.
candidates.af: Die gras golf oor die heuwel. Die beeste het niks agtergekom nie.

candidates.en: The gums are swaying, the grass is rolling. The cattle carry on with supper.
candidates.af: Die bloekoms swaai, die gras rol. Die beeste eet maar aan.

candidates.en: The breeze is moving the jacaranda one street over. The wind chime is narrating.
candidates.af: Die briesie skuif die jakaranda een straat verder. Die windklokkie vertel die storie.

candidates.en: Purple petals blowing across the road. The stoep has the best seats in Pretoria.
candidates.af: Pers blommetjies waai oor die pad. Die stoep het die beste sitplekke in Pretoria.

candidates.en: The cat on the rail is unimpressed by the breeze. Everyone else is delighted.
candidates.af: Die kat op die reling is nie beïndruk met die briesie nie. Almal anders is in hulle noppies.

candidates.en: Friday sundowners with a sea breeze. The palms and the sarong are both dancing.
candidates.af: Vrydag-sundowners met 'n seebriesie. Die palmbome en die sarong dans albei.

candidates.en: Smoke sideways, washing still out, windpump turning. The Karoo breeze is multitasking.
candidates.af: Rook dwars, wasgoed nog uit, windpomp draai. Die Karoo-briesie doen alles gelyk.

candidates.en: The washing should have come in hours ago. The breeze voted to leave it.
candidates.af: Die wasgoed moes ure gelede ingekom het. Die briesie het gestem om dit te los.

candidates.en: Flags on the masts still talking. The boats are done for the week.
candidates.af: Vlae op die maste praat nog. Die bote is klaar vir die week.

candidates.en: Sunday evening, a breeze through the rigging. The harbour's version of a lullaby.
candidates.af: Sondagaand, 'n briesie deur die tuig. Die hawe se weergawe van 'n slaapliedjie.

candidates.en: Leaves keep blowing through the security light. It keeps switching on for nobody.
candidates.af: Blare waai heeltyd deur die sekuriteitslig. Dit skakel aan vir niemand nie.

candidates.en: Stars out, palm moving, and a breeze with Monday night all to itself.
candidates.af: Sterre uit, die palmboom beweeg, en 'n briesie met Maandagaand heeltemal vir homself.

candidates.en: The washing stayed out overnight. The breeze is finishing the job.
candidates.af: Die wasgoed het oornag buite gebly. Die briesie maak die werk klaar.

candidates.en: Somebody forgot the washing. The breeze didn't, and it's drying beautifully.
candidates.af: Iemand het die wasgoed vergeet. Die briesie nie, en dit droog pragtig.

candidates.en: A warm breeze off the sea, palms swaying along. Wednesday night, sorted.
candidates.af: 'n Warm briesie van die see af, palmbome wat saamswaai. Woensdagaand, gesorteer.

candidates.en: Clear sky, white surf, a breeze that's just enough. Durban's night shift is easy.
candidates.af: Helder lug, wit branders, 'n briesie wat net genoeg is. Durban se nagskof is maklik.

candidates.en: The windpump keeps working by moonlight. The breeze doesn't believe in knock-off time.
candidates.af: Die windpomp werk aan in die maanlig. Die briesie glo nie in uitkloktyd nie.

candidates.en: Moon up, grass silver, windpump turning. The dog guards all three.
candidates.af: Maan op, gras silwer, windpomp draai. Die hond bewaak al drie.

candidates.en: The smoke's going sideways, the collars are up, the plates are full. Friday's fine.
candidates.af: Die rook trek dwars, die krae is op, die borde is vol. Vrydag is reg.

candidates.en: The breeze is taking the smoke down the block. Everyone knows what's for supper.
candidates.af: Die briesie neem die rook die blok af. Almal weet wat vir aandete is.

candidates.en: The tablecloth is clipped down and the fairy lights are swinging. Saturday came prepared.
candidates.af: Die tafeldoek is vasgeknip en die liggies swaai. Saterdag het voorbereid opgedaag.

candidates.en: A breeze through the garden, and every light on the string dances a little.
candidates.af: 'n Briesie deur die tuin, en elke liggie aan die string dans 'n bietjie.

candidates.en: Sand drifts across the road grain by grain. Paternoster isn't in a hurry.
candidates.af: Sand dryf korrel vir korrel oor die pad. Paternoster is nie haastig nie.

candidates.en: Sea breeze, stars over the cottages. The dog is the only traffic tonight.
candidates.af: Seebriesie, sterre oor die huisies. Die hond is die enigste verkeer vanaand.

candidates.en: Monday under a grey lid at the rank. Brightest thing here: the coffee.
candidates.af: Maandag onder 'n grys deksel by die staanplek. Die helderste ding hier: die koffie.

candidates.en: The sky's on mute and so is the queue. Monday hasn't found its volume.
candidates.af: Die lug is op mute en die tou ook. Maandag het nie sy volume gekry nie.

candidates.en: Grey sky, grey sea, and one swimmer who doesn't need the sun's permission.
candidates.af: Grys lug, grys see, en een swemmer wat nie die son se toestemming nodig het nie.

candidates.en: The sky and the sea agreed on a colour. Not an exciting one.
candidates.af: Die lug en die see het op 'n kleur ooreengekom. Nie 'n opwindende een nie.

candidates.en: Even the hadeda isn't saying much this morning. The sky set the tone.
candidates.af: Selfs die hadeda sê nie veel vanoggend nie. Die lug het die toon gestel.

candidates.en: Thursday under a grey lid. The dog's walk is the day's main event.
candidates.af: Donderdag onder 'n grys deksel. Die hond se stappie is die dag se hoofgebeurtenis.

candidates.en: Table Mountain pulled the grey blanket right over its head. Friday, same.
candidates.af: Tafelberg het die grys kombers tot oor sy kop getrek. Vrydag, dieselfde.

candidates.en: Mountain under a lid, light on red, Friday moving at half speed.
candidates.af: Berg onder 'n deksel, lig op rooi, Vrydag teen halwe spoed.

candidates.en: A grey sky over the office park. Monday looks exactly how it feels.
candidates.af: 'n Grys lug oor die kantoorpark. Maandag lyk presies soos dit voel.

candidates.en: No shadows, no glare, no excuses. Monday under a Tupperware lid.
candidates.af: Geen skaduwees, geen glans, geen verskonings nie. Maandag onder 'n Tupperware-deksel.

candidates.en: Flat grey sky, no sun to leave streaks. Best car-washing weather all week.
candidates.af: Plat grys lug, geen son om strepe te los nie. Die beste weer om die kar te was, die hele week.

candidates.en: The sun won't be inspecting the shine today. The car is fine with that.
candidates.af: Die son kom nie vandag die glans inspekteer nie. Die kar is tevrede daarmee.

candidates.en: Grey to the horizon. The sheep don't mind; the count's the same either way.
candidates.af: Grys tot by die horison. Die skape gee nie om nie; die telling is in elk geval dieselfde.

candidates.en: The Karoo with the colour turned down. The windpump is the day's excitement.
candidates.af: Die Karoo met die kleur afgedraai. Die windpomp is die dag se opwinding.

candidates.en: Grey sky, grey hills, steady runs. Thursday is happening at exactly the expected speed.
candidates.af: Grys lug, grys heuwels, bestendige lopies. Donderdag gebeur presies teen die verwagte spoed.

candidates.en: Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never has to squint.
candidates.af: Nie een skaduwee op die veld die hele dag nie. Die skeidsregter hoef nooit sy oë te knyp nie.

candidates.en: Grey sky, jerseys on, school's out. The weekend starts without the sun's help.
candidates.af: Grys lug, truie aan, skool is uit. Die naweek begin sonder die son se hulp.

candidates.en: The sky is on mute. The school gate is not.
candidates.af: Die lug is op mute. Die skoolhek is nie.

candidates.en: No sunset tonight, just the promenade lights doing their best. Monday, signing off.
candidates.af: Geen sonsondergang vanaand nie, net die promenadeligte wat hulle bes doen. Maandag teken af.

candidates.en: The sky went from light grey to dark grey. That was the whole show.
candidates.af: Die lug het van liggrys na donkergrys gegaan. Dit was die hele vertoning.

findings: 'lug' means 'air' — nothing in the English source; it is 1 letter from 'lig', the usual word for 'light'

candidates.en: The security light came on before sunset. The sun never really clocked in today.
candidates.af: Die sekuriteitslig het voor sononder aangeskakel. Die son het vandag nooit regtig ingeklok nie.

candidates.en: Gate closed, light on, sky grey. Wednesday ends the way it started.
candidates.af: Hek toe, lig aan, lug grys. Woensdag eindig soos wat dit begin het.

candidates.en: Sea and sky in matching grey. Only the pier lights got dressed up.
candidates.af: See en lug in bypassende grys. Net die pierligte het uitgevat.

candidates.en: Humid, grey and still. Durban's Thursday evening, at a steady six out of ten.
candidates.af: Klam, grys en stil. Durban se Donderdagaand, op 'n bestendige ses uit tien.

candidates.en: The shed light is the sunset tonight. The cattle seem fine with the downgrade.
candidates.af: Die skuurlig is vanaand die sonsondergang. Die beeste lyk tevrede met die afgradering.

candidates.en: Sunday ends under a grey lid. The kraal gate shuts; the week can begin.
candidates.af: Sondag eindig onder 'n grys deksel. Die kraalhek gaan toe; die week kan begin.
